findings: Build CI runs npmci and npmrunvalidate on Ubuntu Node20, checks main.js exists; no Windows/macOS/Android/native Obsidian job. Workflow definition read, no remote run/status independently verified.

Release task repeats validate, checks tag==manifestversion, extracts changelog section with fallbacknotes and publishes main.js/manifest/styles. Tag hyphen marks prerelease. Package/versions agreement, native testing and artifact digests not explicit release gates here. No release/publish invoked.

UI text script recursively scans main.ts/src TS AST, selected fluent UI methods, Notice,addOption,ribbon and createEl/createSpan text object. Literal/template/conditional/concatenation fragments examined without symbol resolution; identifiers/function-return strings are skipped. Not full UI copy coverage or rendered UI test.

Sentence-case checker is heuristic (two capitalized words after first, stop/acronym/properphrase lists); decorative icon check limited regex. Passing cannot certify accessibility/layout/interactions or runtime correctness.
Git precommit hook invokes only UI copy check, not fullvalidate; installing hook remains separate npm script. Archived bot ESLint disables broad non-copy rules and is not active package lint config.

Active ESLint typed TS project with sentencecasewarn, imports globals package not directly declared in reviewed package manifest; resolution may rely on transitive lock/tree. Lockfile/dependency installation not yet assessed. No build failure asserted.

npmrc enables legacy-peer-deps and empty tag prefix. gitignore excludes generatedmain.js/localdata/node_modules/cache while already tracked .code-scalpel artifacts still exist in pinned tree. Ignore rules do not establish absence of tracked artifacts. Empty .hotreload is marker only.
